venues.name: Frog Pond
venues.summary: Find the pond, pavilion, playground and carousel. Choose one thing to do; keep your exit plan simple.

map.alt: North-up landmark map: Frog Pond at the center, pavilion south, Tadpole Playground east, and carousel west. Numbered details follow.
map.routeStatus: Pale paths show geography; short dashed marks show mapped steps. A continuous step-free route has not been verified.
map.credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Map data available under ODbL.

facts.label: Step-free features
facts.text: The City lists stair-free access to spray play and the playground on Boston Common. It does not identify a continuous route here.

facts.label: Restrooms
facts.text: The City lists an accessible portable toilet on the Common. Its exact current location and opening are not verified on this map.

facts.label: A place to pause
facts.text: The City lists shaded seating and benches along paths. No designated quiet or sensory room is verified.

facts.label: Parking
facts.text: The operator directs drivers to Boston Common Garage, with vehicle entry on Charles Street. Garage elevator location and current operation need confirmation.

unknowns: Confirm the step-free entrance and path from your actual parking or transit stop.
Ask staff which restroom is open, accessible and suitable for the changing support you need.
Choose a pause spot and return route when you arrive; open park space is not guaranteed quiet.

landmarks.name: Frog Pond
landmarks.detail: Seasonal skating or spray-pool area. Check the operator for today’s activity and closure notices.

landmarks.name: Pavilion & café
landmarks.detail: Service building beside the pond. The City lists winter restrooms; café operation is seasonal. Accessible stall, changing equipment and current opening need confirmation.

landmarks.name: Tadpole Playground
landmarks.detail: Playground beside Frog Pond. Play access listed by the City does not verify every item or the route from your arrival point.

landmarks.name: Carousel
landmarks.detail: A separate seasonal activity west of the pond. Ask the operator about boarding and transfer arrangements.

venues.name: Life Time Burlington
venues.summary: For a swim visit, ask the front desk to show the route from check-in to changing, pool entry and the exit before you get everyone changed.

facts.label: Location
facts.text: Life Time Burlington is at 186 Middlesex Turnpike. The club lists pools and locker rooms; an accessible interior route is not established by that amenities list.

facts.label: Ask the club
facts.text: Call 617-761-7107 for current arrangements and a preview or tour.

unknowns: Which step-free entrance and changing room should we use?
What pool-entry equipment is available, working and staffed for our visit?
Is there an all-gender/family changing room, adult-size changing table or space for a support person?
Where can we take a quieter break, and which exit returns us to the car?

venues.name: L.L.Bean Flagship
venues.summary: Use the current store map for elevators and restrooms, then the campus map for arrival. The flagship layout changed in September 2026.

facts.label: Elevators
facts.text: Elevators are marked on the official floor plan. Match your arrival entrance to a working elevator with staff.

facts.label: Restrooms
facts.text: The map marks restrooms on Levels 1 and 2, including beside the Kids’ area on Level 2. Individual stall features are not specified.

facts.label: Wellness room
facts.text: A wellness room is marked on Level 2 near Kids’. The map does not describe it as a sensory room; ask staff about access and use.

unknowns: Which entrance is step-free from your chosen parking space?
Which restroom has the changing equipment your family needs?
Is the wellness room available and appropriate for the kind of break you need?

venues.name: Wells Beach
venues.statusLabel: Official beach map & seasonal access notes
venues.summary: Pick one beach access point before setting off. A parking lot, a beach wheelchair and a step-free route are different things to confirm.

officialMaps.label: Open town parking page & beach map

facts.label: Parking
facts.text: The Town lists Eastern Shore and Mile Road as paid Wells Beach lots, and Casino Square as a free lot. Check the current season and signs.

facts.label: Beach wheelchairs
facts.text: The Town’s published 2024 policy places seasonal, first-come chair checkout at 513 Atlantic Avenue. Confirm this year’s operation before relying on it.

facts.label: Restrooms & unloading
facts.text: The parking page says restrooms close with the lots at 11 p.m. It requires loading and unloading within designated public parking areas.

unknowns: Which current beach entrance has step-free access and usable beach matting?
Where is the nearest accessible restroom to that exact entrance?
Confirm wheelchair availability, return time and transfer support with the Town.
